statement.ru: Ради опыта Ньютон просовывал тупую иглу между своим глазом и костью.
statement.en: For an experiment, Newton pushed a blunt needle in between his eye and the bone.

why: Newton's notebook (Cambridge MS Add. 3975) records pressing a bodkin behind his eyeball to study colours.

statement.ru: Никола Тесла умер очень богатым человеком.
statement.en: Nikola Tesla died a very rich man.

why: Having spent most of his money, Tesla lived in New York hotels leaving unpaid bills.

statement.ru: Студентом Байрон держал в Кембридже ручного медведя: собак там запрещали.
statement.en: As a Cambridge student, Byron kept a tame bear, because dogs were banned.

why: Byron kept a tame bear at Trinity out of resentment at rules forbidding pet dogs.

statement.ru: Дарвин был капитаном корабля «Бигль».
statement.en: Darwin was the captain of the Beagle.

why: Darwin sailed as a gentleman naturalist; the captain was Robert FitzRoy.

statement.ru: Дочь Марии Кюри тоже получила Нобелевскую премию.
statement.en: Marie Curie's daughter also won a Nobel Prize.

why: Irène Joliot-Curie shared the 1935 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

statement.ru: Брюс Ли родился в Гонконге.
statement.en: Bruce Lee was born in Hong Kong.

why: Bruce Lee was born in San Francisco, USA, and grew up in Hong Kong.

statement.ru: Сальвадор Дали появлялся на публике со своим муравьедом.
statement.en: Salvador Dalí appeared in public with his pet anteater.

why: Dalí frequently appeared in public with his pet anteater and his ocelot Babou.

statement.ru: Бетховен был глухим с рождения.
statement.en: Beethoven was deaf from birth.

why: Beethoven began losing his hearing around 1798, in his late twenties.

statement.ru: Мохаммед Али пошёл в бокс, потому что у него украли велосипед.
statement.en: Muhammad Ali took up boxing because his bicycle was stolen.

why: At 12, fuming over his stolen bicycle, he was told by a policeman to learn to box first.

statement.ru: Вторую Нобелевскую премию Мария Кюри получила вместе с мужем.
statement.en: Marie Curie won her second Nobel Prize together with her husband.

why: Her second prize (Chemistry, 1911) was hers alone; Pierre Curie had died in 1906.

statement.ru: Полное имя Пикассо состоит больше чем из десяти слов.
statement.en: Picasso's full name is more than ten words long.

why: He was born Pablo Diego José Francisco de Paula Juan Nepomuceno Cipriano de la Santísima Trinidad Ruiz y Picasso.

statement.ru: Толкин родился в Новой Зеландии.
statement.en: Tolkien was born in New Zealand.

why: Tolkien was born in Bloemfontein, South Africa; only the films were shot in New Zealand.

statement.ru: Шон Коннери до славы работал полировщиком гробов.
statement.en: Before he was famous, Sean Connery worked as a coffin polisher.

why: Among his early jobs Connery worked as a coffin polisher.

statement.ru: Джефф Безос начинал Amazon как интернет-магазин игрушек.
statement.en: Jeff Bezos started Amazon as an online toy shop.

why: Amazon began as an online bookstore.

statement.ru: Гроб Чарли Чаплина однажды украли и требовали за него выкуп.
statement.en: Charlie Chaplin's coffin was once stolen and held for ransom.

why: In 1978 his coffin was dug up and stolen to extort money from his widow.

statement.ru: Эйнштейн сам работал над созданием атомной бомбы в США.
statement.en: Einstein himself worked on building the atomic bomb in the USA.

why: Einstein did not work on the Manhattan Project; he was denied clearance as a security risk.

statement.ru: Начало «Кэрри» жена Стивена Кинга вытащила из мусорного ведра.
statement.en: Stephen King's wife fished the opening pages of Carrie out of the bin.

why: King threw the first pages away; Tabitha retrieved them and urged him to go on.

statement.ru: Роджер Федерер играет левой рукой.
statement.en: Roger Federer plays left-handed.

why: Federer plays right-handed (one-handed backhand).

statement.ru: Агата Кристи была среди первых британцев, вставших на доску для сёрфинга.
statement.en: Agatha Christie was among the first Britons to surf standing up.

why: In Waikiki she and her husband were among the first Britons to surf standing up.

statement.ru: Серена Уильямс — старшая сестра Винус Уильямс.
statement.en: Serena Williams is Venus Williams's older sister.

why: Venus is Serena's elder sister.

statement.ru: Брюс Ли однажды выиграл в Гонконге чемпионат по ча-ча-ча.
statement.en: Bruce Lee once won a cha-cha championship in Hong Kong.

why: In 1958 Lee won Hong Kong's Crown Colony Cha-Cha Championship.

statement.ru: Королева Елизавета I вышла замуж за испанского короля.
statement.en: Queen Elizabeth I married the King of Spain.

why: Elizabeth I never married; Philip II of Spain was the husband of her sister Mary I.

statement.ru: В студенчестве Дарвин был в клубе, где пробовали на вкус необычных птиц и зверей.
statement.en: As a student, Darwin was in a club that tasted unusual birds and beasts.

why: The Glutton Club dined on hawk, bittern and an old brown owl.

statement.ru: Бэтмена придумал Стэн Ли.
statement.en: Batman was created by Stan Lee.

why: Batman (DC) was created by Bob Kane and Bill Finger; Stan Lee worked at Marvel.

statement.ru: Роджер Федерер в детстве подавал мячи на теннисном турнире.
statement.en: As a boy, Roger Federer was a ball boy at a tennis tournament.

why: Federer is a former ball boy.

statement.ru: Арнольд Шварценеггер родился в Германии.
statement.en: Arnold Schwarzenegger was born in Germany.

why: He was born in Thal, Styria, Austria.

statement.ru: У Майкла Джексона был патент на ботинки для его танцевального наклона.
statement.en: Michael Jackson held a patent on shoes for his famous dance lean.

why: US patent 5,255,452: shoes locking to the stage for the anti-gravity lean.

statement.ru: Роальд Даль, автор «Чарли и шоколадной фабрики», был лётчиком-истребителем.
statement.en: Roald Dahl, who wrote Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, was a fighter pilot.

why: Dahl served in the RAF in WWII as a fighter pilot.

statement.ru: Палец Галилея выставлен в музее во Флоренции.
statement.en: One of Galileo's fingers is on display in a museum in Florence.

why: The Museo Galileo in Florence shows the middle finger of his right hand.

statement.ru: Шекспир написал около сотни пьес.
statement.en: Shakespeare wrote about a hundred plays.

why: His surviving works include some 39 plays.

statement.ru: У Усэйна Болта искривлён позвоночник — сколиоз.
statement.en: Usain Bolt has scoliosis, a curved spine.

why: Bolt wrote that he has scoliosis, making his right leg shorter than his left.

statement.ru: Леонардо Ди Каприо назвали в честь черепашки-ниндзя.
statement.en: Leonardo DiCaprio was named after the Ninja Turtle.

why: He was named after Leonardo da Vinci (his mother felt him kick at a Leonardo painting); the Turtles appeared in 1984, ten years after his birth.

statement.ru: Боксёр Майк Тайсон держал сотни голубей.
statement.en: Boxer Mike Tyson kept hundreds of pigeons.

why: He kept pigeons as a child and later tended 350 pigeons in Arizona.

statement.ru: Гарри Гудини утонул на сцене во время трюка с побегом.
statement.en: Harry Houdini drowned on stage during an escape trick.

why: Houdini died in hospital of peritonitis.

statement.ru: Джефф Безос в школьные годы жарил еду в «Макдоналдсе».
statement.en: As a high-school student, Jeff Bezos was a cook at McDonald's.

why: In high school he worked at McDonald's as a short-order line cook.

statement.ru: Одри Хепбёрн родилась в Нью-Йорке.
statement.en: Audrey Hepburn was born in New York.

why: She was born in Ixelles, Brussels, Belgium.

statement.ru: Сценарий первого «Рокки» написал сам Сильвестр Сталлоне.
statement.en: Sylvester Stallone wrote the script for the first Rocky himself.

why: Stallone was nominated for the Best Original Screenplay Oscar for Rocky.

statement.ru: Галилей и Ньютон переписывались друг с другом.
statement.en: Galileo and Newton wrote letters to each other.

why: Galileo died in January 1642; Newton was born around a year later.

statement.ru: Фредди Меркьюри сам нарисовал герб группы Queen.
statement.en: Freddie Mercury designed Queen's crest himself.

why: Mercury used his art training to design the heraldic arms for Queen.

statement.ru: Пикассо умер молодым, не дожив до сорока.
statement.en: Picasso died young, before he turned forty.

why: Picasso lived 1881 to 1973, to 91.

statement.ru: Никола Тесла какое-то время работал у Эдисона.
statement.en: Nikola Tesla once worked for Edison.

why: He worked at Continental Edison and briefly at the Edison Machine Works in New York.

statement.ru: Елизавета II в детстве ходила в обычную школу.
statement.en: As a child, Elizabeth II went to an ordinary school.

why: She was educated at home by a governess, Marion Crawford.

statement.ru: В доме Хемингуэя во Флориде живёт много кошек, и у многих лишние пальцы.
statement.en: Lots of cats live at Hemingway's house in Florida, many with extra toes.

why: The Key West house is famous for its Hemingway cats, many of them polydactyl.
